items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: That was his band. He had a big band for the Newport Jazz Festival, and a small group for other things we were playing.

ctx.x: That is fantastic. And the Benny Goodman group, was that his band or was that sort of a formed band for that event.

That was his band. He had a big band for the Newport Jazz Festival, and a small group for other things we were playing. He had a quintet. Quintet maybe it was a septet. But somewhere halfway in between.
Was he interesting to work for? I’ve heard a lot of stories about him.
